newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen rising further on economy hopes.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen rising further on economy hopes.

text.p: Seoul stocks are forecast to gain further on Wednesday with June trade surplus news continuing to boost buying, especially in export sectors, brokers said.
"Hopes of an economic recovery will continue to prevail. Stocks expected to have posted strong first-half performances will also draw attention," said a Sunkyong Securities broker.
The trade ministry said on Tuesday the customs-cleared trade account in June had swung to a $97 million surplus from a $426 million deficit a year earlier.
On Tuesday the surplus news sent stocks to a sharply higher close at 758.03, up 12.63 points or 1.69 percent.
But brokers said profit-taking selling would emerge from the afternoon session, pressuring the index toward the close.
"Buying will be also focused on performance-backed stocks, especially in the cement and petrochemicals sectors," said Park Byung-moon, head of research at LG Securities.
